rights.origin: Original public synthetic literal inputs and independent expected observations

original_scope.meaning: All ten unchanged original expectations are mandatory, including exact unchanged grant after-state, no owner rows/effects and every writer disabled. The existing descriptor admits this E205 scope only; all other original/later groups retain their own gates.

representation.token: Nonempty ASCII letters, digits, underscore, period or hyphen; at most96 bytes, case-sensitive and exact. The finite token selection is inherited from the separately frozen canonical-authority-evaluation-v1 profile; it selects no production namespace or policy.
representation.values: Grant, organization, new-owner and authenticated-operator IDs use the existing checked Identifier; issuance, expiry and supplied trusted observation time use checked UTC milliseconds. Stored grant lifetime must be nonempty.
representation.ownership: The pure consumer borrows already decoded names and typed values, performs no I/O or heap allocation, and bounds every name before comparisons. Byte reads, decoding, allocation, current canonical state, trusted clock health and real authentication remain consuming-adapter obligations.

semantics.configuration: An independently supplied trusted registered namespace/policy selection is checked separately from the current canonical grant and normalized request. Matching unknown grant/request names do not replace this configuration. Fixture names are injected test policy, never compiled production defaults.
semantics.operator: The authenticated operator is an independent typed consumer argument. request.operator_principal_id denotes only the normalized injected trusted operator observation in these fixtures, never an HTTP caller claim or authentication proof. It must exactly match the grant operator; grant names cannot choose the actual executor.
semantics.scope: Grant and request namespace/policy must each equal the explicitly registered selection. Organization must exactly match. New-owner format does not establish its existence, identity proof or membership.
semantics.lifetime: Require issued_at<=now<expires_at. Empty or reversed stored lifetimes are invalid stored data.
semantics.use_and_retirement: Require single_use true, consumed false and recognized_retired false. A retired scope cannot regain use through these scope observations; no grant is consumed or mutated.
semantics.observation: Successful scope match is not writer admission, authentication, a transferable capability, effect fence or lifecycle proof. All results retain writer_admitted false, exact unchanged grant and empty owner/effect collections.

finite_failures.InvalidStoredData: Malformed/oversized canonical grant scope token or empty/reversed stored lifetime.
finite_failures.OperatorMismatch: Selected authenticated operator differs from grant operator.
finite_failures.NamespaceMismatch: Grant or request differs from registered namespace.
finite_failures.PolicyMismatch: Grant or request differs from registered policy.
finite_failures.TenantMismatch: Requested organization differs from grant organization.
finite_failures.GrantExpired: Supplied trusted time reaches exclusive expiry.

runtime_projection.permit: Only each case input, plus explicit fixture_configuration for the unchanged original ten cases. Expected values, case identities, manifest prose and hashes stay outside the runtime/helper projection.
runtime_projection.result: The supplemental observation container separates the unchanged original scope observation from the actual finite internal failure or null. This is a fixture observation, not a public wire schema, first-failure ordering contract or future HTTP body.

forbidden: Caller-supplied trusted verifier, authority, clock-health or lifecycle-proof flags
Live HTTP authentication or registered command admission
Human, live-model, native-release, operational recovery, user or whole-product acceptance
consumer_gate: Independently accept these exact literal meanings and bounded scope before consumer implementation. Actual source, measured support, complete owning/public-only standalone qualification and delivery remain separate. Authentic independently retained lifecycle continuity precedes every product/bootstrap writer.
